# Kammi
> A refuge for writers

Kammi is a minimalist desktop writing application made to strip away all distractions, toolbars, and cloud-syncing anxiety from your writing process.

## Key Features
- **Distraction-Free**: Fullscreen by default with absolutely no UI noise.
- **Personal Check-in**: Greets you by name depending on what time you write.
- **Time-Based Themes**: Five curated themes matching the mood of different times of day (e.g. "First Light", "Midnight", "3 AM", "Golden Hour").
- **Auto-Save**: Continuously saves all your words straight to your locale storage in `~/Documents/Kammi`. You own your words.
- **Typographic Integrity**: Beautiful, classic font defaults like Garamond, Baskerville, and Courier New built to suit your aesthetic.
- **Session Picker**: Pick up any previous writing session easily.

## Platform Support
- **Mac OS**: [Download the latest .dmg from GitHub](https://github.com/Ollilai/Kammi/releases/latest)
- **Windows OS**: [Download the latest .exe from GitHub](https://github.com/Ollilai/Kammi/releases/latest)

## Company Information
Kammi was created by Olli Laitinen to build a better space for novelists, journalers, and creatives.
